plain_english: Surely intolerable to You, sole world-Lord: Your Maheśvaras and other world-folk on one level.
sanskrit_cite: na soḍhavyam avaśyam te jagadekaprabhor idam māheśvarāś ca lokānām itareṣāṃ samāś ca yat

plain_english: Who always follow Your feet with love — wherever gone, they enjoy certain pleasures.
sanskrit_cite: ye sadaivānurāgeṇa bhavatpādānugāminaḥ yatra tatra gatā bhogāṃs te kāṃś cid upabhuñjate

plain_english: Where He is husband and death-ender, whence sickness? Where His fortune is, what other fortune?
sanskrit_cite: bhartā kālāntako yatra bhavāṃs tatra kuto rujaḥ tatra cetarabhogāśā kā lakṣmīr yatra tāvakī

plain_english: By whose moment-pleasure the All is gained — for him all time fills with Your bliss.
sanskrit_cite: kṣanamātrasukhenāpi vibhur yenāsi labhyase tadaiva sarvaḥ kālo 'sya tvadānandena pūryate

plain_english: Moon: Your bliss-rasa drop fallen to earth; sun: Your destroyer-heat's spread spark.
sanskrit_cite: ānandarasabindus te candramā galito bhuvi sūryas tathā te prasṛtaḥ saṃhārī tejasaḥ kaṇaḥ

plain_english: Offering to this third eye of Yours, Lord — sole mark of some unworldly greatness.
sanskrit_cite: baliṃ yāmas tṛtīyāya netrāyāsmai tava prabho alaukikasya kasyāpi māhātmyasyaikalakṣmaṇe

plain_english: Seen by Him alone, one joys in Your vision-etc.; or whose joy somehow — by it You are seen.
sanskrit_cite: tenaiva dṛṣṭo 'si bhavaddarśanādyo 'tihṛṣyati kathañcid yasya vā harṣaḥ ko 'pi tena tvam īkṣitaḥ

plain_english: Those You're pleased with, whose hearts You've won — dragging from Your city, they've made the outer inner.
sanskrit_cite: yeṣām prasanno 'si vibho yair labdhaṃ hṛdayaṃ tava ākṛṣya tvatpurāttais tu bāhyam ābhyantarīkṛtam

plain_english: Apart from You the whole world looks same-eyed — but its Īśvara is You alone, the Uneven-eyed.
sanskrit_cite: tvad ṛte nikhilaṃ viśvaṃ samadṛgyātam īkṣyatām īśvaraḥ punar etasya tvam eko viṣamekṣaṇaḥ

plain_english: Leave aside: without Your power there is no being at all — and those whose denials of You don't stand without You.
sanskrit_cite: āstāṃ bhavatprabhāveṇa vinā sattaiva nāsti yat tvaddūṣaṇakathā yeṣām tvad ṛte nopapadyate

plain_english: If mind stood in You alone, barriers in-outside gone — what else would be needed, Lord?
sanskrit_cite: bāhyāntarāntarāyālīkevale cetasi sthitiḥ tvayi cet syān mama vibho kim anyad upayujyate

plain_english: Others wander, Lord, in the self itself, ill-placed; others wander in the self itself, well-placed.
sanskrit_cite: anye bhramanti bhagavann ātmany evātiduḥsthitāḥ anye bhramanti bhagavann ātmany evātisusthitāḥ

plain_english: Even untasted Your devotion-nectar, unseen You — by mere conduct with You, beings perfect.
sanskrit_cite: apītvāpi bhavadbhaktisudhām anavalokya ca tvām īśa tvatsamācāramātrāt siddhyanti jantavaḥ

plain_english: We are Your servants, Lord — so as You bear Yourself for three worlds, bear us too, fully.
sanskrit_cite: bhṛtyā vayaṃ tava vibho tena trijagatāṃ yathā bibharṣy ātmānam evaṃ te bharttavyā vayam apy alam

plain_english: Though seen in supreme-bliss-nectar, in the world-self — for touch-rasa with You I hunger exceedingly.
sanskrit_cite: parānandāmṛtamaye dṛṣṭo 'pi jagadātmani tvayi sparśarase 'tyantatarasutkaṇṭhito(?) 'smi te

plain_english: All sorrows even of worldlings — joined to Your ghee-self, become bearable.
sanskrit_cite: deva duḥkhāny aśeṣāṇi yāni saṃsāriṇām api ghṛtyākhyabhavadīyātmayutāny āyānti sahyatām

plain_english: With You — omniscient, omnipotent, consciousness-formed — somehow the world's show, though unreal, is fitting.
sanskrit_cite: sarvajñe sarvaśaktau ca tvayy eva sati cinmaye sarvathāpy asato nātha yuktāsya jagataḥ prathā

plain_english: Breathed by You, qualities throb — even clod-like — dancing wind-tossed like cotton fluff.
sanskrit_cite: tvatprāṇitāḥ sphurantīme guṇā loṣṭopamā api nṛtyanti pavanoddhūtāḥ kārpāsāḥ picavo yathā

plain_english: If self-pride in qualities were not — then by what would the world's show of sole-selfness with You stand?
sanskrit_cite: yadi nātha guṇeṣv ātmābhimāno na bhavet tataḥ kena hīyeta jagatas tvadekātmatayā prathā

plain_english: Venerable even the dissolved great ones, purified by Your anger-fire-touch.
sanskrit_cite: vandyās te 'pi mahīyāṃsaḥ pralayopagatā api tvatkopapāvakasparśapūtā ye parameśvara

plain_english: With Your broad-light body standing plain — Lord, why do I spread in darkness on all sides?
sanskrit_cite: mahāprakāśavapuṣi vispaṣṭe bhavati sthite sarvato 'pīśa tat kasmāt tamasi prasarāmy aham

plain_english: You alone undivided, my nectar-nature — yet of mortal natures I alone am the seat.
sanskrit_cite: avibhāgo bhavān eva svarūpam amṛtaṃ mama tathāpi martyadharmāṇām aham evaikam āspadam

plain_english: Whose speech-ornament is the name "Maheśvara," whose head bears the bow-mark — he alone is powerful.
sanskrit_cite: maheśvareti yasyāsti nāmakaṃ vāgvibhūṣaṇam praṇāmāṅkaś ca śirasi sa evaikaḥ prabhāvitaḥ

plain_english: Since You are being and non-being — then effortlessly, by own tune, Lord, why is accomplishment not mine?
sanskrit_cite: sadasac ca bhavān eva yena tenāprayāsataḥ svarasenaiva bhagavaṃs tathā siddhiḥ kathaṃ na me

plain_english: Śiva's slave, Śiva-selfed — what joy would he not reach? By whom even chief gods are sated with nectar-wine.
sanskrit_cite: śivadāsaḥ śivaikātmā kiṃ yan nāsādayet sukham tarpyo 'smi devamukhyānām api yenāmṛtāsavaiḥ

plain_english: Between heart and navel, beings' bile-bodied — You devour, great fire, all moving-unmoving.
sanskrit_cite: hṛnnābhyor antarālasthaḥ prāṇināṃ pittavigrahaḥ grasase tvaṃ mahāvahniḥ sarvaṃ sthāvarajaṅgamam
